title: Go and See
text: Go now and see how your brothers and the flocks are faring, and bring word back to me.

title: Looking for My Brothers
text: I am looking for my brothers …

title: Reuben's Plan
text: Let us not take his life,

title: The Empty Pit
text: … they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, with no water in it.

title: Spices Bound for Egypt
text: Their camels were carrying spices, balm, and myrrh on their way down to Egypt.

title: Sell Him
text: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay a hand on him; for he is our brother, our own flesh.

title: Twenty Shekels of Silver
text: … sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

title: The Boy Is Gone
text: The boy is gone! What am I going to do?

title: Dipped in Blood
text: Then they took Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a young goat, and dipped the robe in its blood.

title: Camel Tracks
text: … to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

title: God Was with Him
text: But God was with him and rescued him from all his troubles.

title: Refused to Be Comforted
text: All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted.

title: Sold to Potiphar
text: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.

title: Benjamin
text: But his father called him Benjamin.
